[[Weather Institute]] }} '''Hanging Around With Slaking I''' (Japanese: '''VS ケッキング I''' ''VS {{tt|Kekking|Slaking}} I''), titled '''VS Slaking I''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 209th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 29th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Third Choice''' (Japanese: '''３つ目の選択肢''' ''Three Choices'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Three Choices''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} On {{rt|119|Hoenn}}, [[Gabby and Ty]] drive down the road as it begins to rain, causing [[Mr. Stone]]'s {{p|Castform}} to change into its Rainy form. Free to cover their story, the two look for {{adv|Norman}} and {{adv|Ruby}} to get information about the team clad in red that attacked [[Captain Stern]]. Suddenly, Castform begins knocking on the car window, causing Ty to assume that it's being hostile again. Gabby, however, correctly guess that Castform is actually pointing at something——the [[Weather Institute]]. Upon checking, they find Norman holding Ruby up by his throat. Norman punches Ruby into a wall again and demands to know why he ran away from home. When Ruby informs the {{tc|Swimmer}} of the situation, the Swimmer suggests that he should give up and go home. In his head, Ruby calculates three different choices he has: one, to apologize to his father; two, to escape and run away again; three, to stay and fight his father. Having no choice, Ruby decides to stay and fight in order to show his father how serious he is about {{pkmn|Contest}}s. Although he admits to the Swimmer that apologizing would be better, Ruby chooses to fight and requests that he does not watch the fight between him and Norman. Ruby charges into battle and sends out [[Kiki]] and [[Nana]] to face Norman's {{p|Vigoroth}} and {{TP|Norman|Slaking}}. Despite their strength, Nana and Kiki are easily swept away because Norman knows all of Ruby's strategies, as he was the one to teach them to him. Ruby's confidence isn't shattered, as he reveals to his father his newest team member, [[Mumu]], and that his first two Pokémon were nearly decoys for a trap he set up. Mumu fires a {{m|Mud Shot}} into a pipe, which sends several balls of mud flying towards Norman and his Pokémon. Gabby and Ty soon reach the Swimmer, who tells them about Norman and Ruby's battle. ==Major events== * {{adv|Ruby}} faces his father in battle to force him to let him do {{pkmn|Contest}}s. * [[Gabby and Ty]] arrive at the [[Weather Institute]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Castform}} (Rainy Form) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Ruby}} * {{adv|Norman}} * [[Gabby and Ty]] * {{tc|Swimmer}} {{adv|Jack}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Mightyena}} ([[Nana]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Delcatty}} ([[Kiki]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Marshtomp}} ([[Mumu]]; {{adv|Ruby}}'s) * {{p|Vigoroth}} ({{adv|Norman}}'s) * {{p|Slaking}} ({{OP|Norman|Slaking}}) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo|Mr. Stone]]'s; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Castform|Normal and Rainy Forms}}) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * {{adv|Norman}} claims that he taught [[Nana]] {{m|Hyper Beam}}. However, {{p|Poochyena}} is [[manga move errors|unable to learn it]] in the games. ** This was changed in the {{pmin|Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese}} translation, with Norman saying he taught {{adv|Ruby}} Hyper Beam. ===Translation edits=== [[File:PS209 no edit Chuang Yi.png|thumb|175px|Chuang Yi version of this scene.]] * In the [[VIZ Media]] version, the scene where Norman slaps Ruby while asking why he ran away from home is changed to Norman being startled by a bolt of lightning and accidentally losing his grip on Ruby's shirt. ==In other languages== {| |- style="vertical-align:top" | '''Title''' {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 請假王 I|VS Slaking I}} (Taiwan)
